## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `979070ff57b27daf5ce6d7100d4256bd2cda0957`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + none
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: ruled

Read: card #35230 (body and all 13 comments), PR #37070 (body, file list, net diff against `main`), the 48 check-runs on the head, and the cited rule text in the tree at the head and at `origin/main` `1b3b1b47`. Nothing was built or run. In this record "edit 1" to "edit 4" are the PR's own rows S1 to S4; the ids S1, N1, N2 below are this review's findings.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set and public surface: no change. The diff is four one-line edits in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (4 insertions, 4 deletions); no package, schema, script, test or workflow is touched. Right.
- Gates: 48 check-runs on the head, 23 success, 25 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. Right.
- Merge with current `main`: `main` moved after the merge base `938a48f11` (PR #36954 edited `area-lease.md` and `triage-duties.md`). The merge is clean. The merged sizes are `SKILL.md` 33917 (ceiling 33919), `area-lease.md` 6581 (6586), `lanes/qa.md` 2235 (2235), `triage-duties.md` 13697 (13709); all at or under the ceilings on `main`. The PR body's `area-lease.md` figures (6584 to 6582) are the merge-base readings and are one byte stale against `main`; no effect.
- Byte ratchet: three files shrink and no `CEILINGS` row is lowered. Allowed. The header of `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` says a ceiling "may be LOWERED by any PR that shrinks its file" and calls the headroom "the budget for ordinary rule edits"; lowering is permitted, not required. Not a finding.
- Rule change, hunk by hunk against the ruling the PR quotes (「同意」 2026-11-18 16:19Z, to the review order whose step 2 is "fix every passage in the fleet skills that contradicts the rules #35207 lands", per the card body):
  - Edit 1 (`SKILL.md:97`) changes what the index row counts toward the area threshold. It copies `references/area-lease.md:9` on `main` (「可认领卡 ≥15 张且跨 ≥3 个互不相干的模块簇」), and report row A5 names counting p1/p2 as a contradiction. Covered.
  - Edit 2 (`area-lease.md:27`) moves a pointer; it changes no rule.
  - Edit 3 (`lanes/qa.md:7`) is report row B-10, second half. Covered.
  - Edit 4 (`triage-duties.md:108`) drops 「非 hold 的」 from the human floor. Read literally this widens the floor, but the set it adds is empty: `references/state-machine.md:17` (「入 hold ⛔ 不降级」), the `pm:on-hold` row of `SKILL.md` (line 118) and North Star Priority rule 3 ("A paused area no longer demotes its cards to p3") already forbid a demotion on hold, and `seat-lifecycle.md:60` says 「级不动」. No action a seat could take without the maintainer before now needs him. The carve-out is the residue of the retired hold demotion that A5 names. Covered.
  - So every rule-bearing hunk re-aligns to a merged rule inside the ruled step: `ruled`, equal to the PR's declaration.
- `Fixes #35230`: the card's done-when is bounded to the reports' section 2. Spot-checked on the head: no p1/p2 pick line is left (the one `p1/p2` hit, `triage-duties.md:32`, is the self-triage rule), `lanes/triage.md:15` is fixed, `lanes/spec.md` and `lanes/skills.md` now write `Suggested-grade:` with 「级归分诊」. No in-repo section 2 passage in this lease was found still contradicting. `Fixes` holds, subject to the two hand-offs under ③.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `.claude/**` ships in no package. `Clause-②: no` is right: nothing published changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- Deviation "S3 measured differently": the dev is right. On `main`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:13` says "An area is a standing label and opens no issue" and a sub-epic is "a temporary `pm:epic` issue"; Priority rule 3 names "a held or paused area", so an area can be paused. The edit stands on child cards and milestones existing only under a sub-epic (`seat-lifecycle.md:53`). The wording chosen is finding S1 below.
- Deviation "ceiling rows not lowered": accepted, see ①.
- Edit 2 target: grading does live in `references/filing-gate.md` (section 「定级判据」, from line 57), and the lane section of `SKILL.md` (lines 159 to 186) carries no grading clause; its line 180 is 「`domain:*` 与队列只由分诊落笔」. The self-triage exception is at `triage-duties.md:32-35`, so the parenthesis is still true. `lanes/triage.md:14` already points grading at `filing-gate.md`. Right.
- Out-of-scope item, carrier #37060: that card was closed as folded at 2026-11-24 18:40Z; its three items are now a row on the open sweep card #35768 (comment 7140919029). The carrier is live, but the PR body points at a closed card. Escalated to the seat: name #35768 beside #37060.
- Out-of-scope item, carrier "cloud": the cloud halves of C18 (cloud checklist-test line 96) and B-11 are named in the PR body but sit on no card, and `Fixes` closes the only card that lists them. The cloud repository is not readable from this session either. Escalated to the seat: hand both to the cloud seat (mailbox or a cloud card) before the close-out; otherwise the PR owes `Part of`.
- Not carried anywhere: C18's third item. `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md:44` still spells a selector `area:records-forms` with no sentence saying it is not the `area:*` label. It is a naming clash, not a contradiction of the #35207 rules, and it is outside this lease. Escalated to the seat as a possible row beside #37060's item 3.
- SQL push-down: no code in the diff; nothing to check.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md`

S1 (should-fix) — line 7, 「未暂停子专题卡全关 ⇒ 里程碑验收」 names the wrong thing closed. Everywhere else in this skill a child card is 「子卡」 (`seat-lifecycle.md:53-61`, `seat-post-protocol.md:69`, `triage-duties.md:96`), and 「X 卡」 means the issue that IS X: 「`pm:epic` 卡 `pm:retriage` 即答」 and 「`pm:epic`/`tracking` 卡不带 type」 (`triage-duties.md:69`, `:75`). By that usage 「子专题卡全关」 reads as "the sub-epic issues are all closed", so the QA seat's self-start would wait for the epic to close instead of firing when a milestone's child cards close (`seat-lifecycle.md:57`: 「只当前里程碑是卡…其子卡全关」). The old text was unclear about 专题 but clear about 子卡; the edit fixes the first and loses the second. The file is at its ceiling (2235 of 2235), so 「子专题子卡」 costs 3 bytes that must be paid for by deletion; 「未暂停 epic 子卡全关」 is byte-neutral (27 bytes, as now) and is what B-10 asked for (「`pm:epic` 子专题」). Either keeps 子卡.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`

- Edit 1 holds against `area-lease.md:9`: the threshold counts claimable cards, not p1/p2.
- N1 (nit) — the same edit also turns 「即可启用」 into 「即启用」, which no ruling or section 2 row asks for. It does not contradict the detail file (`area-lease.md:9`, 「不足即照常按卡认领」, already reads as a two-way switch, and the seat still re-judges at each seating), so it is wording. 「可认领卡越分区阈值可启用」 is the same 36 bytes if the permissive form is wanted.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`

- Edit 2 holds; see ③. No finding.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`

- Edit 4 holds; see ①. No `Restart-grade`, 「降 p3」 or other hold-demotion twin is left in `.claude/**` beyond `state-machine.md:17`, which reads the stored grade back up.
- N2 (nit) — stale twins of the form edit 3 retires. 「专题子卡」 still stands for a sub-epic's child cards at `triage-duties.md:93` (a file this PR edits), `filing-gate.md:7` and `filing-gate.md:50`. The PR body says each has "a parent issue, child cards or a milestone beside it"; at `triage-duties.md:93` and `filing-gate.md:50` the only cue is the word 子卡, the same cue `qa.md:7` had. Low risk, since 子卡 implies a parent issue and an area has none, but the dev report gives them "carrier: none". Fix them with S1 (`triage-duties.md` has 12 bytes of headroom, `filing-gate.md` has 0) or give them a row on the sweep card.
- Old forms elsewhere in `.claude/**` on the head: none. 「越分区阈值」 with p1/p2, 「定级照 SKILL」, 「未暂停专题」 and 「非 hold」 no longer occur; the remaining 「域车道」 hits point at the lane table for file ownership, not grading.

Summary: S1 is open on this head and earns a delta review of its fix; N1 and N2 can ride that fix or go to the sweep card.
